objective: Maximize usable horizontal space in the BUKLOD Bible reader on portrait Android screens while preserving comfortable landscape gutters and all reader behavior.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: Android Production OTA workflow run 41291297116 completed successfully from source SHA 5d8214355a8a5ea12ecfd5c0c1e520fe4e263944 on 2026-11-01. DEV main at 2c2b8d8eb1c708a574f6de645f9435c0c35609d4 includes the published-source successor commits, KL chapter recovery and monthly QMP clarity; this PR is based on that exact DEV main and changes only Bible Reader horizontal spacing. Physical Android rendering remains intentionally unverified.
chosenApproach: Reduce portrait reader horizontal padding from 16dp to 6dp, landscape padding from 22dp to 14dp, and verse-row horizontal padding/gap from 5dp/9dp to 2dp/7dp. Preserve 100% content width, text font size and line height, bottom safe-area inset, narration, annotations and chapter navigation.
selectionRationale: The screenshot shows excessive horizontal whitespace. The current reader already uses full width; its content gutters are the direct controllable cause. A small portrait gutter maximizes text width without changing font scale or scroll architecture.
alternativeApproaches: Changing global shared screen padding would affect unrelated screens.
Reducing font size would not reclaim the wasted page margins and would harm readability.
Changing navigation or safe-area layout is unrelated and increases regression risk.
preserveBehaviors: Bible translation, book and chapter selection
Verse text size and 26dp line height
Other app screens and global shared styles
acceptanceChecks: Portrait gutter is 6dp and landscape gutter is 14dp
Verse row horizontal padding is 2dp and gap is 7dp
Text font size and line height remain unchanged
No OTA or production deployment without separate release gates
